journey.name: Onboard offline: an unreachable API stays retryable
journey.description: Failing to reach Anthropic says nothing about whether the key is good, so the screen reports the connection instead of condemning the key.

actions.action: Enable airplane mode on the device
Type "sk-ant-api03-any-key-at-all" into the "Anthropic API key" field
Wait until an error about being offline is displayed under the field
Verify the message does not say the key was rejected
Verify the button now reads "Try again"
Disable airplane mode on the device
Verify the offline error is no longer displayed
